name: Ikaijin
source:
[spoiler]A transdimensional being that watches over the events of [i]World's End Club[/i]. They can communicate with Pochi, an X-TYPE, and assists him in the Go-Getters' adventures across Japan. They give subliminal instructions to the Go-Getters when they're in trouble, and they're able to travel through time and witness alternate histories, gathering clues and avoiding the Go-Getters' deaths.

The Otherworlder represents the Player in the story.[/spoiler]
